title: Overlap distributions under the Gibbs measure of a Haar model of $\log|ζ|$ on and near the critical line
summary: We study the Gibbs measure of $H(h) = \Re\sum_{p^{j} \leq X}U_{p}^{j}/(j p^{j(σ+ i h)})$, a random field modeling large values of the log-modulus of the Riemann zeta function on and near the critical line, where the $U_{p}$ are independent and uniformly distributed on the complex unit circle. Writing $t = \log \log T$, the cutoff $X$ and real part $σ$ may vary with $T$ subject to $T^{1/t^Φ} \leq X \leq T^{1/t^φ}$ and $0 \leq σ- 1/2 \leq C_σt^Φ/\log T$, for fixed $Φ\geq φ> 1/2$ and $C_σ > 0$.
